description: E1-E3: deterministic verification of the discrete Caputo operators and of the implicit L1 reference solver; E5: positivity of the implicit L1 step for GKSL generators. (E4, the SOE study, is configured in soe.json.)

E1_l1_operator.metrics: max over nodes and final node of |D_h f - D^alpha f|, and the weighted maximum max_n t_n^alpha |D_h f(t_n) - D^alpha f(t_n)| that enters the discrete stability bound

E1_truncation.function: u = E_alpha(-lambda t^alpha), the solution of E3: truncation error R^n = D_h u(t_n) + lambda u(t_n)

E2_alpha_gradient.reference: central difference of the discrete sum evaluated with mpmath (60 digits, step 1e-20) on the same double-precision nodal values
